description: Hand-labeled company reply emails for evaluating the response classifier. label.classification is the ground truth; ambiguous replies are labeled UNKNOWN because the intended behavior is to route them to human review rather than guess.

items.body: Hello, we have received your request and opened ticket REF-88123. Our team will review it shortly.
Your personal data has been permanently deleted from all of our systems. This action is complete.
Before we can proceed, we must verify your identity. Please confirm your identity by replying with a photo of your ID.
To locate your records we need more information. Please provide your account number and the email used at signup.
We are unable to delete your data because we have a legal obligation to retain transaction records for seven years.
Thanks for getting in touch. We'll be in touch about your inquiry at some point in the future.
This is an automated acknowledgement that your message was received. Reference number: CASE-4471.
All information associated with your account has been erased as requested. Nothing further is required from you.
We cannot action this request as submitted; your account could not be found and the request is denied.
For your security, please confirm your identity by providing proof of address before we continue.
We need additional information to proceed. Please provide your full order id and date of purchase.
Some of your records were deleted, but we are unable to remove others at this time. Details to follow.
Hi there, just following up on our end. Regards, the team.
Your request has been received and is now in our processing queue. Ticket: REF-90210.
We have processed your request and your profile no longer exists on our platform.
We have received your request. We cannot give you an exact completion date yet, but it is in progress.
